answer.text: HEY holds no published project for that contract. That is a statement about HEY’s index, not about the token; verify_project says what HEY recorded about the contract itself. A published project carries this token’s name or ticker on a different contract: "priors-agents" on 0xedbf91223639800bcd5756815caf908df3b890be (the same name and ticker). On chain a token is its contract, never its name or ticker.

disclaimer.text: Public, source-backed activity HEY recorded. Still Building means counted ships during a market drawdown HEY itself tracked — it is not a prediction, not a ranking by price, and not investment advice. Few projects meet Still Building or Under the Radar at any time; both are strict by design, and list responses carry the counts.
